The native target was declared-but-inert on three layers at once and all three are now wired: notification_rules.TARGETS carried `native` with the comment 'accepted and persisted but inert', its only consumer being a metadata annotation nothing read; desktop/main.js imported Electron's Notification solely for isSupported(); and the frontend listed native in INERT_TARGETS so a user could tick a checkbox that did nothing. native_delivery(rule, capability) is now one pure function with three outcomes, wired at the single delivery choke point on the immediate path only, consulting `available` rather than `granted` because macOS never reports notification authorization.
